critical: W0's own verdict (not converged or a loading > 1.001 at its solution)
W4_mps16: validated on block 0 of base rank 0: max |dVm| 3.6e-06 p.u., |dVa| 9.4e-06 rad vs genco.solve (cpu)

protocol.order: per base: pre-outage inference timed (CPU b1, MPS b1; min of 3); then for each workflow in ['W0', 'W1', 'W4', 'W4s', 'gate', 'CF0.1', 'CF0.2', 'CF0.5', 'CF1']: 5 untimed warm-up outages (the first of the sample), then 3 complete passes over the sample in branch-id order (per-outage perf_counter around the complete sequence, contiguous wall per pass recorded); then W4_mps16: one untimed warm-up block, then 3 passes over the blocks
protocol.sample: numpy default_rng([2026, rank]).choice(candidates, 200, replace=False), sorted; candidates = in-service non-bridge branches of design(); ids in `samples`
protocol.warmup: 5 untimed outages per workflow and base, one untimed MPS block per base; the first base's first MPS block also validates the batched forward against genco.solve
protocol.mps_sync: torch.mps.synchronize() before the shared timer stops (then .cpu() of the outputs, also inside the timer)
protocol.repetitions: 3; latency columns ms = min per outage, ms_first = first pass, ms_mean = arithmetic mean; totals: ms_total_first = sum of the first pass (no min-taking), pass_wall_ms_first = contiguous wall of the first pass summed over bases, ms_total_min = sum of the per-outage minima; summary mean/median/p90 are over the per-outage minima
protocol.partial_batches: the last block of a base may hold fewer than 16 outages; it is timed as is and its size stored per row (block_size); amortized throughput in `mps_blocks` = total block wall / outages
protocol.gate_rule: flag if max one-step loading > c = 1.001 or mismatch > tau_mw of the start (or the step is impossible)
protocol.solver_failure: newton(max_it=30): a flagged run is carried on for up to 30 more iterations; if it does not converge (or the start has no step) the outage is re-solved from the pre-outage start (restarted=True, +30 iterations max); still not converged -> failed=True, flagged, W0 counts it critical; ms includes everything executed, ms_cont the continuation/restart part
protocol.classical_first: W1's step first; GENCO stage (inference + anchored start + step + gate tau_hyb) where max loading > c or mismatch > tau1 (tau1 in [0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0]); all executed work timed; `second` marks outages that reached the GENCO stage
protocol.mismatch_gate: inference, both starts' initial mismatch (timed), smaller takes the step with its tau (tie / NaN -> pre-outage)
protocol.pre_outage_inference: per base, timed separately (base_inference); not in the per-outage columns; the scorer amortizes it over the base's outages
